description: This file is a Python script that sets up and runs an AI-powered conversational pipeline involving speech-to-text, language modeling, and text-to-speech services within an interactive bot. It includes configuration of various external services, event handlers for client connection management, and the main execution logic for deploying the bot.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Represents the conversational context for the language model, encapsulating system messages and user data.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Pairs the LLMContext with user parameters and strategies for managing conversation state.

classes.name: LLMUserAggregatorParams
classes.description: Holds parameters related to user-specific aggregation strategies, including turn stop strategies.

classes.name: UserTurnStrategies
classes.description: Defines strategies for managing user turn-taking behaviors during conversations.

classes.name: TurnAnalyzerUserTurnStopStrategy
classes.description: A strategy that determines when to stop a user's turn based on a turn analyzer.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines the sequence of processing steps for the conversational pipeline.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates an executable pipeline with its parameters and settings.

classes.name: PipelineParams
classes.description: Contains configuration parameters for the pipeline execution, such as metrics flags.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Handles the execution and management of the pipeline, including starting and cancelling.

methods.name: run_bot(transport: BaseTransport, runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Sets up the services, constructs the pipeline, and manages client connection events to run the interactive bot.

methods.name: bot(runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Main asynchronous entry point to initialize the transport and start the bot pipeline.
